status_scope: Data aggregation completeness only; not acceptance. Inspect warnings, runtime-age, hash, execution-order, quality and manual visual audits independently.

execution_order_audit.rule: All case/config warmups first; then repeat outer loop, case order from previous cases.json inner loop, configuration shift=(repeat+case_index)%len(configs).

protocol.execution_order: All case/config warmups first; then repeat outer loop, case order from previous cases.json inner loop, configuration shift=(repeat+case_index)%len(configs).
protocol.phase_separation: Primary and optimization use different raw files, baselines, summaries, CSVs, Markdown and figure folders. Never pool repetitions across phases.
protocol.quality: Unmasked RGB LPIPS Alex spatial map, averaged globally or over common old R0 bands; source resized with LANCZOS; far background from old allowed_box. F is a computational reference, not true editing ground truth.
protocol.extra_background: MAE(candidate,source,far)-MAE(same-phase F,source,far), not MAE(candidate,F,far). Negative values can occur and do not prove successful editing.
protocol.formal_target: Quality gate plus >=10% end-to-end net latency reduction relative to F. Three previously viewed demos and three timing repetitions only screen this target; no formal Go, significance, noninferiority, CI or independent-seed success-rate claim.
protocol.fixed_controls: Compare ROT with the arithmetic mean of three FIX metrics and also disclose each FIX and metric-specific best FIX. Per-metric best names may differ; these are hindsight diagnostic controls, not an automatically selectable deployable oracle.
protocol.optimization_controls: CHANNEL is the projection-aware per-output-channel Value correction using zero mean and unit variance priors, without sample calibration. Compare with contemporaneous F/R2 and count all correction work. Earlier scalar and rotation results remain separate cohorts.
protocol.visual_review: Manual visual review is performed separately. Numeric gate passing does not establish absence of brightness blocks, seams, text errors or identity changes.
